identity.one_liner: 基于 Playwright 的反检测浏览器自动化与免费验证码求解框架
identity.review: 基于 Playwright 的浏览器自动化框架，当前仅提供 async 模式，可与既有 playwright 代码即插即用，只需替换浏览器初始化。隐身机制包括使用本机真实 Chromium 启动被控浏览器、以自采集 chrome 指纹构造假浏览器指纹；内置免费验证码求解，用计算机视觉/AI 方法（reCognizer、hcaptcha-challenger、CLIP、cv2.matchTemplate 等）处理 reCaptcha、hCaptcha、geeTest v3/v4 等类型。pip 安装，GNU GPL，允许商用但须公开源码与版权。
highlights: 与既有 playwright 代码即插即用，仅改浏览器初始化
基于本机真实 Chromium 与自采集指纹库做浏览器伪装
内置免费验证码求解：reCaptcha、hCaptcha、geeTest v3/v4
README 附 reCaptcha/CreepJS/Cloudflare/DataDome 等检测测试表
use_cases: 自动化脚本需要通过网站反机器人检测
机器人流程中自动求解 reCaptcha、geeTest 等验证码
为已有 Playwright 代码增加指纹伪装能力

evidence: L108: It uses Computer Vision/Artificial Intelligence and other Methods to solve these Captchas.
L110: You dont need to pay for any Captcha Solving APIs and you can solve Captchas with just one simple function call.
L60: ### It is fully plugable with your existing playwright code. You only have to change your browser initialization!
